items.source_en:
Hello Supervisor Aigner,

This is Angela, your project manager for this star system. I wanted to give you a heads up that management is going to visit your site in a few days. HQ is trying to get some new investors to fund more projects, and they want to show them how things work at one of our sites. 

We want to put our best face forward, so we need you and your crew to get your site looking spotless. That includes the crew's quarters, so give everything in there a good scrub-down. And make sure to get rid of any contraband! Management wants to put on a good show for the investors, it'll be both our jobs if they find something they don't like.

Thanks!

Angela

It's been a difficult road and I never imagined having to do this... But we found the perfect place for our beloved Allie's ashes. Her favorite lullaby was about stars and I sang it every night. So, what better place to finally lay her to rest than among the stars?

Allie was our world and ever since that day we just haven't been the same. My wife took it especially hard. We've barely spoken, she barely eats, but goddamn it I never expected this.

I did everything I could but it was too late. Last night she did the unthinkable. I have no idea what's left for me...
